label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Coody Leads St. Jude
items.text: Pierceson Coody is the early leader at FedEx St. Jude Championship, sitting at 1-under par through 2 holes with Jackson Koivun, Sam Stevens, Harris English, and Maverick McNealy tied at even par.

items.headline: McIlroy Targets FedEx Cup
items.text: Rory McIlroy returns to FedEx St. Jude Championship aiming for a fourth FedEx Cup, currently ranked 12th in standings as he starts his three-event playoff push.

items.headline: McIlroy PGA Tour Status
items.text: McIlroy may fall one start short of the PGA Tour's 15-event minimum, but a potential handbook waiver for medical or extraordinary reasons could preserve his status and exempt him from limitations.
